sloka: व्याहरन्ति मृगा घोरा रक्षसां निधनं तदा ।समापतन्तो योधास्तु प्रास्खलन् भयमोहिताः ।। ६.५३.१५ ।।।।
transliteration: vyāharanti mṛgā ghorā rakṣasāṁ nidhanaṁ tadā ।samāpatanto yodhāstu prāskhalan bhayamohitāḥ ।। 6.53.15 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the fierce animals indicated the death of Rakshasas, who were going deluded with war and fell down.
